items.title: Cal Collins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 11, 1997
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe and we are interviewing today... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you very much.

ctx.x: Cal was interviewed at the Allegheny Jazz Party in Chautauqua, New York on September 11, 1997 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are interviewing today for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a great pleasure to have Cal Collins, guitarist, with me today.
